events.title: 노리치 시티 sign defender Andy Linighan from 올덤 애슬레틱 for £300,000.
After seven months at 포츠머스, Ian Baird returns to 리즈 유나이티드 for £120,000.

루턴 타운 edge closer to a remarkable cup double by defeating 포츠머스 3–1 in the FA Cup quarter-final at Kenilworth Road , while 윔블던's hopes of a first Cup final appearance move closer to reality with a 2–1 win over 왓퍼드. 아스널 blow their hopes of a cup double by losing 2–1 at home to 노팅엄 포리스트. Maurice Evans resigns as manager of struggling 옥스퍼드 유나이티드.
리버풀 move closer to a unique second double by thrashing 맨체스터 시티 4–0 in the FA Cup quarter-final at Maine Road .
웨스트햄 유나이티드 sign 풀럼 striker Leroy Rosenior for £275,000.
리버풀's unbeaten start to the league season is ended when they lose 1–0 in their 30th match to neighbours 에버턴.
John Hollins resigns as 첼시 manager and is replaced by his assistant Bobby Campbell .
아스널 sign winger Brian Marwood from 셰필드 웬즈데이 for £600,000, while Trevor Francis ends his brief spell with Glasgow 레인저스 to join 퀸스 파크 레인저스 on a free transfer.
노팅엄 포리스트 pay 프레스턴 노스 엔드 £150,000 for 18-year-old striker Nigel Jemson . 리버풀 defender Mark Lawrenson retires from playing after an injury at the age of 30 and is appointed manager of 옥스퍼드 유나이티드.
첼시 sign goalkeeper Kevin Hitchcock from 맨스필드 타운 for £250,000.
루턴 타운's hopes of a cup treble are ended when they are beaten 4–1 by Second Division strugglers Reading in the Full Members' Cup final at Wembley.
Cameroon wins the 1988 African Cup of Nations by defeating Nigeria : 1–0. The only goal in Casablanca 's Stade Mohammed V is scored by Emmanuel Kundé from a penalty kick .

리버풀 finish March with a 14-point margin over second-placed 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the First Division. At the bottom, 왓퍼드 are eight points from safety with eight matches left, and 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 and 포츠머스 are also struggling in the relegation zone. 애스턴 빌라 remain top of the Second Division with a two-point margin over 블랙번 로버스, with the play-off places being occupied by 미들즈브러, 밀월 and 브래드퍼드 시티. 리즈 유나이티드, 크리스털 팰리스 and 스토크 시티 remain in strong contention for promotion as well.
